The '''''Second Breath''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was used by the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]-based company [[Renna's Transport Service]].

{{RPG|[[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']]}}
In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]], the owner of the Transport Service, made the ''Second Breath'' available to the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents that she had hired to deliver a cargo of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. The agents subsequently flew the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to Druckenwell from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and they landed the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the landing pad [[docking bay 1138]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Second Breath'' was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]], and it appeared in [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']], a [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy|''Looking In'' trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the adventure, the players&mdash;who [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the Heroes of Cularin&mdash;are offered the use of the ''Second Breath'' by Renna if they lack a starship of their own. If none of the player characters have any [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] abilities, then Renna also provides them with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-W3]], who flies the ship for them.
